CREATE TABLE advisories(source TEXT, source_id TEXT, revision TEXT, digest TEXT, json TEXT, observed_at TEXT, published TEXT, updated TEXT, state TEXT CHECK(state IN ('active','withdrawn','quarantined')), PRIMARY KEY(source,source_id));
CREATE TABLE advisory_evidence(source TEXT, source_id TEXT, facet TEXT, identity TEXT, release TEXT, package TEXT, platform TEXT, scheme TEXT, "range" TEXT, status TEXT, fix TEXT, provenance TEXT);
CREATE TABLE advisory_shells(source TEXT, source_id TEXT, identity TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(source,source_id,identity));
CREATE TABLE advisory_support(source TEXT, source_id TEXT, identity TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(source,source_id,identity));
CREATE TABLE affected_latches(watch_id TEXT, record_id TEXT, episode INTEGER, latched INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(latched IN (0,1)), PRIMARY KEY(watch_id,record_id,episode));
CREATE TABLE baseline_members(source TEXT, source_id TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(source,source_id)) WITHOUT ROWID;
CREATE TABLE coverage_inheritance(child_id TEXT, parent_id TEXT, watch_id TEXT, reason TEXT, episode INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(child_id,parent_id,watch_id,reason,episode));
